title: circaea lutetiana subvar. cordifolia
intro: Circaea lutetiana subvar. cordifolia, commonly known as Enchanter's Nightshade, is a plant species within the evening primrose family (Onagraceae) and is native to Europe. The Enchanter's Nightshade plant has been utilized for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Enchanter's Nightshade, specifically the glycosides, are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
